description: This file defines an Angular component named TodoItemComponent, which provides a presentational UI for displaying a single todo item, including toggling completion and removal functionalities.

classes.name: TodoItemComponent
classes.description: A presentational Angular component for rendering a single todo item, supporting toggle and remove actions.

methods.name: onToggle
methods.description: Handles the toggle checkbox change, emits the todo ID to indicate toggling completion.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles the remove button click, emits the todo ID to indicate removal.
